project: Saga X Agent Desk - Realistic 3D AI Agent Upgrade
objective: Replace the existing SVG/cartoon agent avatars with realistic interactive 3D avatars while preserving the existing Agent Desk UI, database, authentication, agent logic, and GPT-5.6/Luna integration.

primary_agent.name: Putri
primary_agent.avatar_style: Realistic 3D female digital human, Korean-inspired beauty and premium corporate executive aesthetic.

visual_direction.face: Elegant Korean-inspired facial features, attractive symmetrical face, natural realistic skin, expressive eyes
visual_direction.outfit: Luxury fitted dark navy or black executive suit with tasteful premium styling

hard_requirements: First inspect the existing project structure and package.json before changing code.
Do not rebuild the application from scratch.
Do not remove or break the existing Desk, Chat, Kelulusan, or Aktiviti features.
Do not change the existing agent backend or GPT-5.6/Luna logic unless required for the avatar integration.
Keep existing database, authentication, API routes, agent memory, and business logic intact.
Implement the 3D avatar as a reusable component so the same system can later support CEO, CTO, CFO, CMO, and COO.
Use GLB/GLTF as the preferred runtime 3D model format for the browser.
If the existing frontend is React or Next.js, prefer Three.js with React Three Fiber and @react-three/drei.
Do not assume the project uses React. Detect the actual framework first and adapt the implementation.
Do not expose API keys or secrets in frontend code.
The application must remain usable if the 3D model or optional voice service fails.

implementation_phases.name: Inspect Existing Project
tasks: Inspect package.json.
Identify framework, frontend entry point, routing, component structure, API structure, and existing agent implementation.
Locate the current SVG/avatar component.
Locate the current CEO/Putri agent card.
Identify how chat messages are sent to the existing LLM agent.
Identify whether text-to-speech or speech-to-text already exists.

implementation_phases.name: 3D Avatar Foundation
tasks: Add only the required 3D dependencies compatible with the existing framework.
Create a reusable AgentAvatar component.
Load /avatars/putri/putri.glb.
Add camera, lighting, responsive sizing, and proper model positioning.
Support GLB animations if animation clips are available.
Do not hardcode the avatar to the CEO role; make model path and agent metadata configurable.

behavior.idle: Subtle breathing, blinking, natural eye movement if supported.
behavior.listening: Face the user/camera and show a subtle listening state.
behavior.thinking: Use subtle head/eye movement and a restrained thinking animation.
behavior.speaking: Play speaking animation and lip-sync to the generated audio.
behavior.error: Return to idle and show a non-blocking error state.

implementation_phases.name: Voice Conversation
tasks: Preserve the existing text chat.
Add microphone input only if the browser and current architecture support it safely.
Convert user speech to text using the project's existing speech-to-text capability if available; otherwise implement a modular STT adapter.
Send the resulting text to the existing Putri CEO agent.
Use the existing GPT-5.6/Luna response without changing its personality or business logic.

implementation_phases.name: Text To Speech And Lip Sync
tasks: Create a modular TTS adapter instead of hard-coding a vendor into the UI.
When the CEO response is ready, generate or receive speech audio.
Play the audio in the browser.
Drive basic mouth-open movement from audio amplitude as the first working version.
If the GLB contains facial morph targets/blendshapes, map mouth/jaw controls to the audio.
If phoneme/viseme data is available from the selected TTS provider, add a more accurate viseme-based lip-sync layer.
Stop/reset speaking state when audio ends.

implementation_phases.name: Integrate Into Current Agent Card
tasks: Replace only the existing SVG/avatar visual area inside the Putri CEO card.
Keep Putri name, CEO role, status, activity, task information, and existing card interactions.
Make the 3D canvas responsive to the card dimensions.
Do not introduce a full-screen 3D scene unless the existing UI already uses one.
On card selection, allow the user to open the existing chat or conversation interface.

implementation_phases.name: Reusable Multi-Agent Architecture
tasks: Create agent configuration data for Putri, Alisya, Julia, Farah, and Delisha.
Each agent should specify name, role, avatar model path, voice configuration, personality identifier, and visual theme.
Reuse one AgentAvatar component for all agents.
Do not duplicate avatar logic per agent.

performance_requirements: Optimize GLB size for web delivery.
Dispose Three.js resources correctly when components unmount.
Do not render hidden avatars unnecessarily.
Keep the current dashboard fast on desktop and mobile.
fallback_behavior: If GLB fails to load, show the existing avatar or a clean placeholder.
If TTS fails, display the text response normally.
If microphone/STT is unavailable, retain text input.
If facial morph targets are unavailable, use basic audio-amplitude mouth movement or speaking animation.
acceptance_tests: Existing Saga X Agent Desk loads normally.
Putri card displays the GLB 3D avatar instead of the SVG avatar.
Putri can still be selected and chatted with.
Avatar switches correctly between idle, listening, thinking, and speaking.
No API secret is exposed in client-side code.
Existing Desk, Chat, Kelulusan, and Aktiviti functionality continues to work.
The implementation is reusable for the other four agents.
developer_instruction: Work incrementally. Before editing, inspect the repository. After each major change, run the existing build/typecheck/lint commands if available. Prefer small, reversible changes. Report exactly which files were created or modified and explain any dependency added.
